request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin scrap warship: the hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with riveted gunmetal scrap plates; the grey castles become rusty scrap iron; the red sails become patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched pale hide patches; the pennants become brown rags. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
